packet.question: Did Amazon's FY2024 10-K attribute AWS sales growth to higher pricing rather than customer usage? Explain the stated direction of the pricing effect.

answer.answer:
Increased customer usage was the primary driver of AWS sales growth.
Pricing changes partially offset that growth; higher pricing was not the stated positive driver.
AWS sales will double next quarter.
